metadata.title: The Way Home
metadata.description: Complete this End City branch with rods, shells, and a concluding tower survey.

tracker.text: Survey the marked End City tower.
tracker.complete_text: The End City tower is surveyed.

tracker.text: Place 12 End rods as return markers.
Bring 2 shulker shells for the archive.
